recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (#F5F5F5).
2. Add the title text "Stopping Criteria" in bold red (#C00000) sans-serif, centered horizontally at the top of the slide.
3. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at the top-right corner containing the black (#000000) text "24".
4. Draw a rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) border and no fill in the upper-middle area, spanning from the left to the right edge of the content area.
5. Inside the top rectangle, add the left-aligned text "[1] Total Error = zero (Theoretical)" in black (#000000), with the bracketed number "[1]" in blue (#0000FF) and "(Theoretical)" highlighted with a yellow (#FFFF00) background.
6. Inside the top rectangle below line [1], add the left-aligned text "[2] Total Error < certain value (Threshold)" in black, with "[2]" in blue.
7. Inside the top rectangle below line [2], add the left-aligned text "[3] Percentage Change of Weights is less than certain value (Threshold)" in black, with "[3]" in blue.
8. Inside the top rectangle below line [3], add the left-aligned text "[4] Reach Maximum number of iterations (Epochs) without satisfying [2] or [3]" in black, with "[4]" and "Epochs" in blue.
9. Draw a second rectangle with a thin red (#C00000) border and no fill in the lower-middle area, spanning from the left to the right edge of the content area, positioned below the top rectangle.
10. Inside the bottom rectangle at the top, add the left-aligned text "Stopping is due to reaching Maximum number of iterations = Training is FAILED" in red (#C00000).
11. Below the failure header, add the left-aligned text "Expected Reasons:" in red (#C00000) with an underline.
12. Below the subheader, add the left-aligned text "[1] The defined Maximum Number of Epochs is small. Try to increase the limit" in black, with "[1]" and "Epochs" in blue.
13. Below reason [1], add the left-aligned text "[2] Under-fitting (Training samples are not adequate). Try to provide more training samples" in black, with "[2]" and "Under-fitting" in blue.
14. Below reason [2], add the left-aligned text "[3] Model Design is not suitable to training data. Try to add more nodes in hidden layer or add more hidden Layers" in black, with "[3]" and "Model Design" in blue.
15. Below reason [3], add the left-aligned text "[4] Data is NOT separable by Neural Network. Try Another Models (e.g. SVM with Kernels)" in black, with "[4]" and "Data is NOT separable" in blue, and "(e.g. SVM with Kernels)" highlighted with a yellow (#FFFF00) background.
